spec_match.rationale: Emits the real ExtensionSettings schema (per-extension or * scope, runtime_blocked_hosts / runtime_allowed_hosts) in the three real deployment carriers, and its impact line states the 155 attach consequence including the allowed-hosts non-exemption.

interactive.rationale: Live extension-id validation (32 chars a–p) with aria-invalid, per-pattern grammar validation, live impact statement, format toggle, and copy — all reactive to every keystroke.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises an admin tool with pattern validation and three output formats; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid IDs and patterns flagged inline; empty blocked-list case states the gate will NOT trigger; plist output escapes XML; registry output collapses to one-line JSON as Windows requires.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5072259281715200, the ExtensionSettings policy reference, and the match-pattern doc.

conformance.rationale: The manual assertions in the feature suite give the exact verification recipe this page's step-3 checklist walks an admin through.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP matrix both classes; autorun swaps in a concrete extension id and the rendered JSON reflects it; zero console errors; copy fallback path present for clipboard-denied contexts.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on every render with format and validity.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; invalid state uses rose border plus text error, not colour alone; format buttons pair colours.

accessibility.rationale: for/id labels, aria-invalid + aria-describedby on the id field, aria-pressed format toggle, aria-live validation list and impact line, role=status copy note, focusable pre output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow on either class via CDP; policy JSON wraps; grid collapses at 360.

openQuestions.title: Offer the update_url'd force-install context fields
openQuestions.detail: Real ExtensionSettings deployments often combine runtime_blocked_hosts with installation_mode/update_url. Adding those optional fields would make the output paste-ready for more orgs, at the cost of scope — evaluate whether it stays a focused debugger-gate demo.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Explicit label association, validation messages tied to fields via aria-describedby, aria-invalid reflecting state after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: extid uses for/id + aria-describedby=extid-err + aria-invalid; pattern verdicts render adjacent to the textarea they describe in an aria-live list.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Mirror visual validation state programmatically so screen readers hear what sighted users see.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Error text and aria-invalid are set/cleared together in the same render pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: grid2 auto-fit; .gen has overflow-x:auto plus wrapping-friendly font size.

summary: Admin-side tool: the policy JSON that arms the 155 gate, validated as typed and exported in three deployment formats. Verified via CDP on both classes with autorun.
